info.name: BlueConic REST API v2 Audit Events Interactions API

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the current page. Either this one or `referer` must be provided in order to get interactions returned.

params.name: referer
params.description: The referer of the current target to retrieve the interactions, which can be an URL for web channels, a screen name for mobile or CTV channels, or a campaign ID for email channels.

params.name: channelId
params.description: The channel ID of the channel to retrieve the interactions for. If not passed, it's derived from the `url` or `referer` parameter.
